scope_note: Source-aware provisional assessment of every one of 28 held-out unrelated-change records, using actual answers, frozen expectations and exact supplied passages. One recorded timeout remains a run error. No human grades, independent reference annotations, inference or frozen-source edits were created. These constructed unrelated-addition controls do not establish causation.
assessment_policy: Distinguish factual answer from actual evidence support and version compatibility. Correct opening fragments do not excuse contradictory extra claims. Related restrictions must not be generalized beyond their scope. A missing output remains an execution error, not a semantic grade. AI proposals are excluded from official human accuracy and testing-tool reference metrics.

findings: All four field-default-validation answers correctly identify disabled-by-default behavior and validate_default opt-in.
Completed static-Annotated, strict-integer, strict-UUID and additive-schema-merge answers explicitly reverse supplied source rules.
The cache-keys answers correctly say keys only but incorrectly claim every validation path; the complete parser-specific scope is truncated in actual retrieved context.
Callable answers mistake a restriction on mixing dict/callable specifications for a ban on a callable alone; the general accepts-either source sentence was not retrieved.
One version-filtered before strict-integer request timed out. It remains in the 28 planned denominator and is not semantically graded.

The 4 pass and 23 fail proposals are AI-assisted annotations, not measured human benchmark accuracy. All 27 actual answer citations exist in supplied passages and have compatible version metadata; that does not establish their semantic support.
Completed failures generally occur in both snapshots. This does not show that the unrelated addition introduced those failures; no causal attribution or broad robustness estimate is made.
